comparison.rule_tested: Exactly a two-pixel perimeter ring, no scaling or interpolation.

sources.label: Domain/OS SR10.4, HP VUE 2.01, Search Directories focused field
GTK 2.24.33 GtkEntry with mapped X11 focus, DomainOS palette

comparison.result: Both captures exactly match the same two-pixel focus-frame mask at their own native dimensions. The DomainOS GTK role renders the same focus RGB as the SR10.4 capture. This is a shape/color comparison; the widget sizes and surrounding themes are different.

method.algorithm: For each source ROI, compare the pixels equal to the focus RGB against x<2, x>=width-2, y<2, or y>=height-2; no resampling.

measurement_note: The R57 search-field ROI began at x=229 and omitted its leftmost focus pixel. Reinspection of the hash-matched capture locates the full 338x34 field ring at x=228..565, y=404..437. This corrects only the comparison ROI; R57's saved file and historical claim are preserved.
limits: Exact focus-frame mask parity does not establish selected-text behavior, caret shape, caret blink, widget natural dimensions, or other GTK2 controls.
The GTK2 capture is a real mapped X11 window under Xvfb without a window manager; KWin/session integration remains separate.
The live SR10.4 clone still shows no VUE desktop, so no new guest interaction was possible.
next: Preserve the verified two-pixel dynamic focus frame. Continue only unresolved GTK2 states; compare selected text/caret with the VUE guest when visible.
